svg.title: Synthetic Data Generator overview
svg.desc: Real, unedited sentences about the water cycle generated by gemma4-32k through Ollama in all 13 supported languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Malayalam, Kannada, Nepali and Sinhala. Pipeline: topic, languages and model, then prompt, clean, check script, dedupe, mix and export to TXT, JSON, CSV, PDF or MP3.
svg.text: Training data in 13 languages from any open-source LLM in Ollama · free, no API key
Unedited sentences from examples/ · gemma4-32k via Ollama · topic “The water cycle”

text.style: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: වතුර චක්‍රය පෘථිවියේ ජීවයට අත්‍යවශ්‍ය වේ.
PDF output uses Noto fonts for every script, with proper letter shaping and right-to-left Urdu
One command, any model you have in Ollama
Asks your local LLM, in each language's own words
Strips numbering, bullets and intro lines
≥70% of letters must be in the right script
Drops repeats, asks again until there are enough
Splits samples by your percentages, then shuffles
